tasks.description: Validate that improved error handling constructs do not introduce command injection risks or mask original exit codes.

Audit the systemd sandboxing directives in neos-autoupdate.service and neos-liveuser-setup.service. Ensure no critical privileges are unnecessarily granted. Ensure ReadWritePaths are strictly minimal.
tasks.resolution: Dropped CAP_SYS_MODULE and ReadWritePaths=/srv from neos-autoupdate.service (unused by pacman/snapper). CAP_SYS_ADMIN kept — flagged as unverified without a full VM boot+update test. neos-liveuser-setup.service intentionally left unsandboxed per its own inline comment + regression-guard test.
